answer: Give subsidized requests for voyage plans or zephyr forecasts to human controllers through simultaneous attendance ceremonies. Hold every site at the same time; independent witnesses admit each person once and issue a credential. Each weekly claim reveals a credential-derived nullifier that the shared registry accepts only once across all agent keys. Aliases cannot forge additional attendance. More quota requires recruiting and paying extra people to show up. This assumes honest witnesses, unforgeable credentials, and controls against credential lending.
